belief: If I'm not liked online, I don't matter.
origins: Likes, followers, shares, and comments feel like measures of worth, and they trigger the brain’s reward systems. Young people especially can tie self-esteem to numbers. A post with few responses can feel like rejection, and silence can feel like being forgotten.
teaches: Paul asks, “Am I now seeking the approval of men, or of God?” Proverbs says, “The fear of man is a snare, but whoever trusts in the LORD is set securely on high.” The psalmist says, “I praise You, for I am fearfully and wonderfully made,” and God declares, “The LORD your God is among you… He will rejoice over you with gladness.” God told Samuel, “Man sees the outward appearance, but the LORD sees the heart.” Our worth was set at creation and sealed at the cross, and no number of likes can raise or lower it.
self_statements: No likes means no one cares.
My worth is my follower count.
I have to post to be seen.
errors: Feeling ignored and concluding I do not matter.
Believing I am either popular or worthless.
questions: What do I hope likes will give me?
How do I feel when a post gets little response?
Who in real life values me, regardless of a screen?
What does God say about my worth?
What would change if I posted without checking numbers?
What offline activity could remind me of my value?
truth: Likes measure attention, not worth. God made me, loves me, and delights in me. I can use social media without letting it decide who I am.
hw_truths: My worth is not a number.
The fear of man is a snare.
I can post without needing applause.
log: Each day, note one person who values you in real life.
actions: Go offline for a day or weekend.
Turn off like counts if possible.
Spend time face to face with those who love you.
Say it when you check the numbers.
prayer: Father, I have looked to likes for worth. Remind me that You delight in me. Free me from the fear of man, and let me share without needing applause. Amen.
hw_questions: What do I hope likes give me?
How do I feel when posts flop?
What if I did not check numbers?
name_example: Sarah can write: “The Lord rejoices over me, whatever the numbers say.”
meta: Christian belief counseling for “If I'm not liked online, I don't matter.” with BSB scriptures, questions, songs, and practical homework.
